北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京真冷，体感 -10℃。记得多穿衣，注意保暖哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is very cold, feels like -10℃. Remember to dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪风大体感冷，北风 4级。多穿点，小心着凉呀。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is windy and feels cold. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天微凉，气温 4℃。注意增减衣物，别感冒咯。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and cool at 4℃. Adjust your clothing, stay well!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州风力 5级，体感 8℃。风大注意防风，小心着凉。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has strong winds, feels like 8℃. Watch out for the wind!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳风力 4级，体感 11℃。阳光虽好，也要注意防风呀。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny but windy, feels like 11℃. Enjoy the sun, stay warm!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州体感 -1℃，阴冷。多穿厚衣服，别冻着了哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou feels like -1℃, cloudy and cold. Bundle up!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，体感 -1℃。注意防寒保暖，别着凉了呀。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, feels like -1℃. Stay warm and don't catch a cold.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 3℃。微凉，记得添衣哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and cool at 3℃. Remember to add a layer!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，体感 -2℃。出行注意安全，记得添衣保暖。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is very foggy, feels like -2℃. Drive safely and stay warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安多云，湿度 100%。潮湿阴冷，注意防寒哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and 100% humid. It's damp and cold, stay warm!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆大雾，湿度 97%。驾车出行请注意安全，放慢车速。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is very foggy, 97% humid. Drive safely and slowly!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒！体感 -25℃。务必穿最厚的衣服，注意防冻。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -25℃! Bundle up to prevent frostbite.
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -25℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷！体感 -23℃。注意保暖，出门记得多穿点。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and cold, feels like -23℃! Stay warm and dress in layers.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -23℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴天，气温 10℃。天气舒适，享受阳光吧！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and 10℃. A comfortable day, enjoy the sunshine!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴天，体感 11℃。注意防风，多晒晒太阳吧！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny, feels like 11℃. Enjoy the sun, but mind the breeze!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛风力 5级，体感 -12℃。风寒效应强，务必多穿！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is very windy, feels like -12℃. Dress warmly against the wind chill!
青岛.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 5级

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连风力 5级，体感 -18℃。风大天冷，记得全副武装。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is very windy, feels like -18℃. Bundle up for the cold wind!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -18℃ | 💨 北风警报：西北风 5级
